pages.text: Pick the output fluid by clicking its layer in the controller's tank, then:$(br2)- $(l)Bucket$() it straight from the Drain, or$(br)- $(l)Power the Drain with redstone$() to pump into connected Fluid Pipes — 5 mB per tick along the network, straight to your casting tables.
pages.title: Getting Metal Out

pages.text: $(l)Fluid Pipes$() come eight at a time — bricks around a glass core. Each pipe carries one fluid at a time; right-click a face to flip it between in, out and disconnected.
Wrap a finished pipe in bricks to get the $(l)Drain$() itself. Every forge needs at least one.
